title: research: add segment-local PR2250 refinement and nested source replays
body:
## Summary

```text
retained PR2250 primitive
  -> segment-relative Tape view
  -> park current roles / install local delimiters
  -> nested retained-source execution
  -> erase child segments / restore parent heads
```

Add a scoped local tape refinement and nested continuation prototype. Frozen PR2250 source is retained unchanged; early/late compact calls and the actual FOUR/base event8814 right-recipe phase execute through the adapter. The proof accounts for payload-local origins, a bounded role inventory, dirty ancestors and local cleanup. Descriptor serialization and restoration use a Python control-stack oracle; physical control-frame boundaries and location are unimplemented.

The exact implemented payload-boundary bill is 2H+4k. The separately reported 6D descriptor charge assumes known frame boundaries/lengths and is only a conditional transport model. Zero uses ell(0)=1 in the header-length formula.

This is partial interface work: the recursive C child and delivery of its designated output into the real parent packet remain unimplemented. The phase fixture uses an address-invariant restriction; it is not a full production monomial replay. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

- **Before:** inherited `rewind()` reaches backing zero and inherited `erase()` destroys dirty ancestor contents; both failures execute as controls.
  **After:** complete reduced f=2 early/late compact rectangles run at two nested levels with ancestor lengths 16, 257 and 4096, identical local counts and exact parent-byte/head restoration. Peak role count is 10 of 16 fixed payload slots.
- **Actual recipe:** unchanged `phase_pass` and its inverse agree with an independent Gaussian-integer oracle on 1024 phase-invariant addresses for event8814's nine-bit right recipe (offset426, phase1). The cooperating packet package supplied these local source-derived bytes; complete dispatcher provenance remains its obligation.
- Python 3.12 normal and `-O` direct replays pass with byte-identical results in under one second combined; no production census, native supplier, Lean, Docker or full build ran. Source hashes are checked before imports. Standard metadata, registered normal/-O, committed-byte/source-history checks and official export integrity checks pass. Git-free exported replays with an empty PATH reproduce the committed RESULT.json byte-for-byte (0.190s normal, 0.360s optimized).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way.

**Blast Radius:** Isolated.

Only a new research package. The physical finite-role argument is written; Python weak references simulate role lifetimes. Initial current origins are caller entry state, and subsequent nested origin installations are charged. Complete actual packet/child output integration remains open.

Credit: Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml PR2250, Douglas Colkitt's compact identity/guard/repair, Cinna Davis PR4100/4088, Matarener cover/stock work and JoyboyBrian PR5041. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Task, overlap and remaining work

Task `b2_complex_local_suspend` / `uniform-transfer-audit`; [canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5012#discussioncomment-19140803). Scientific base `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`, priority revision 7. The delivered scope is explicitly narrower than the original complete-adapter objective; the README and PROOF record the unimplemented obligations and Open next questions.

Pre-submission checkpoint: canonical main `ff3cc58e3` was fetched on 2026-10-23; governing guidance and selected record are unchanged. Fresh advisory overlap covered 371 open PRs and 4587 discussion records with complete reported pagination; no competing implementation of this precise scoped result was found. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside this coverage. Official metadata, committed-byte/source-history, package export/check and optimized Git-free replay pass. A separate Astra source/proof review found no remaining actionable issue at the submitted head. This is scoped AI-assisted evidence, not human/proof-kernel acceptance.
